              授業科目の学習・教育目標

              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.Electrical and electronic engineering
2.Electricity as energy
3.Electricity as a means of information and communications
4.Green Transformation (GX)
5.Digital Transformation (DX)

              Students will learn about general education on electrical and electronic engineering that is necessary for GX (Green Transformation) and DX (Digital Transformation). Electrical and electronic engineering consists of six areas of learning: Power & Energy, Electric Machines & Controls, Energy Materials & Devices, Optical Devices & Semiconductors, Information and Communications & Electromagnetic Waves, and Acoustics & Imaging. Students will acquire the general education to understand electrical and electronic engineering news through the course objectively.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The course is an omnibus-style course given by six professors. The course provides an overview of electrical and electronic engineering, which is necessary for the GX and DX technologies. This course will offer the starting point for the electrical and electronic engineering exploration journey.
